title: UK-based currency hedging platform MillTech raised $60M from Apax Digital Funds at a $325M valuation, and plans to expand in North America and build AI tools (Carter Johnson/Bloomberg)
summary: Carter Johnson / Bloomberg: UK-based currency hedging platform MillTech raised $60M from Apax Digital Funds at a $325M valuation, and plans to expand in North America and build AI tools — Currency hedging and cash management platform MillTech raised $60 million in a deal with Apax Digital Funds …
